records.deidentified_narrative: unit 1 was being towed by rio wrecker service out of alamo, tx (tow truck permit number- tdlr0006486185004im). unit 1 was being unloaded from the flat bed tow truck on the public roadway. unit 1's emergency brake was activated. unit 1 was not secured by the tow truck's chains. the tow truck driver could not disengage the emergency brake. andy flores assisted the tow truck driver by disengaging the emergency brake. unit 1 began to travel in reverse with no driver inside and the driver's door ajar. andy flores was caught between the door of unit 1 and another vehicle that was parked adjacent to where unit 1 was traveling. the door of unit 1 struck andy flores on his right side causing the door to open wider damaging the hinges and the door. one of the left tires of unit 1 struck andy flores on the left leg. unit 1 kept traveling in reverse and struck unit 2 on the front end (concentrated damage) with its back right. the tow truck driver departed from the location prior to police arrival. i, trooper juan mendoza, attempted to make contact with the tow truck driver to no avail.

records.deidentified_narrative: on january 26, 2021 at approximately 1844, i ofc. j. fitch of the teague police department was dispatched to the 300 block of business us84w/loop225 for a report of a pedestrian struck by a motor vehicle. i arrived to find no pedestrian or vehicle, but i was able to locate a witness who lived across from the scene, gloria dixon. gloria stated that she was in her living room when she heard a loud noise outside and went to investigate. it was in front of her residence that she saw an older model chevy colored with what appeared to be primer paint which was gray in color. it was located in the west bound shoulder of business us84w/loop 225 and positioned in front of the truck was what appeared to be an injured and upset younger white female, the driver of the truck appeared to know her and ask if she was alright, [person] that the [medical facility]. the driver then loaded up the female and left the scene. i collected the information from the witness and then contacted freestone county dispatch to check with local hospitals to see if any females had been recently brought in with injuries. a short time later, dispatch notified [medical facility] in fairfield, tx who told medical staff that she had been struck by a motor vehicle. i asked dispatch to notify fairfield pd so they could send an officer to hold the individual with her and collect [roadway] there. once i arrived i met with the driver ty mccormick, ty stated that the person struck was his girlfriend, jessica gardner, and that she was injured. he also said it was an accident and it occurred when he went to pull over to pick her up. while ty waited in the lobby, i spoke with jessica about the incident, she stated that she had left an apartment they were at on foot but then became cold on the walk home and called ty to pick her up. while ty was pulling over he inadvertently struck her with the front right fender, causing an injury to her right ankle. jessica was clear in the fact that she believed this was an accident and blames the incident on ty's truck due to inadequate brakes. i took photographs of the injuries and was informed by medical staff that the ankle may be broken. i then went outside and took photographs of the truck and collect any possible evidence. i was not able to locate any other evidence. the contributing factors for the driver are defective brakes and dark lighting conditions. the pedestrian was also not walking against the flow of traffic, which did not allow her to observe oncoming vehicles. this incident appears to be an accident, no citations were issued but a report was taken. end of reportofc. j. fitch #205

in color. it was located in the west bound shoulder of business us84w/loop 225 and positioned in front of the truck was what appeared to be an injured and upset younger white female, the driver of the truck appeared to know her and ask if she was alright, [person] that the [medical facility]. the driver then loaded up the female and left the scene. i collected the information from the witness and then contacted freestone county dispatch to check with local hospitals to see if any females had been recently brought in with injuries. a short time later, dispatch notified [medical facility] in fairfield, tx who told medical staff that she had been struck by a motor vehicle. i asked dispatch to notify fairfield pd so they could send an officer to hold the individual with her and collect (unit 2) with the mirror of is unit 1 [roadway]. while i was in route to the call i noticed unit 2 was sitting on [roadway]. i then pulled over along with my cover officers and went to unit 2. i asked my cover officer c. noda #0914, and officer n. mendoza #1727 to stay with unit 2 while i went to make contact with unit 1 [roadway] off the roadway. i then contacted unit 1 and asked the driver what happened. unit 1 stated [roadway] [roadway] and stated he did not see unit 2. unit 1 stated unit 2 ""came out of nowhere"" and after he struck him with his vehicle he exited the roadway and ran to see if he was okay. i asked unit 1 where exactly unit 2 was at on the roadway prior to being hit. unit 1 stated he wasn't exactly sure he just knows unit 2 was on the right shoulder of the [roadway]. unit 1 stated he struck unit 2 with his passenger mirror, that i observed had been broken off due to hitting unit 2. i could smell a slight odor of intoxicants coming from unit 1 so i asked unit 1 where he was coming from. unit 1 stated he had just finished working one of the venues at the rodeo near by. i asked unit 1 if he had any type of alcohol consumption tonight and he said ""yes"" but it was earlier in the night. i then asked for a dwi officer to come my location to evaluate unit 1 driver. i was advised by my cover officer n. mendoza #1727 that unit 2 had sustained some serious injuries and would be transported to the location listed above. i then contacted tid detective m. salazar #2260 to inform her of the call due to unit 1's injuries. tid detectives advised me they would be making the scene and told me to make sure to get csi to come to my location for photos. csi c. imler #9420 arrived on scene for photos. dwi officer k. williams #0820, also arrived on scene to evaluate unit 1 driver. tid arrived on scene and was advised by the dwi officer that he did not believe unit 1 driver was intoxicated beyond the legal limit. i also advised tid that [medical facility] and unit 2 told the officer that he was walking on the roadway prior to being hit. after tid detectives finished their investigation they advised me that there were no signs that showed unit 1 swerved prior to crashing and that unit 2's hat and other belongings were in the roadway indicating that unit 2 was walking in the roadway prior to being struck and unit 2 would be at fault. unit 1 driver was provided a [case id] for insurance purposes and was released on scene. unit 2 received a broken left humorous, right cheek fracture, collar bone damage and fractured ribs on both sides that were caused by the accident. no further action taken at this time. dmea
